$schema.description: Editor metadata only; gdfmt never fetches this URL.

extends.description: Local JSON files, applied in order before this file. No package or URL resolution.

format.description: Script layout, indentation, line endings, blank lines and final newline.

ignore.description: Gitignore-style patterns, relative to this file. Replaces an inherited list.

overrides.description: Ordered overrides append across inheritance layers and run after all base fields.

root.description: Stop parent directory configuration discovery at this file. Default: false.

ConfigOverride.description: Ordered, path-scoped layout/language changes. Paths are relative to the declaring JSON file.

exclude.description: Exclude globs using the same path rules.

files.description: Include globs, matched against the full relative path; an empty list matches nothing.

LanguageVersion.description: Explicit grammar profiles, not a claim of complete engine conformance.

finalNewline.description: End formatted files with one newline. Default: true.

indentWidth.description: Visual tab width or number of spaces per indentation level. Default: 4.

lineEnding.description: Physical line endings. Default: lf; preserve uses the first newline, or lf.

lineWidth.description: Target print width; long indivisible tokens may exceed this value. Default: 100.

godotVersion.description: Explicit grammar profile. Default: 4.7. Does not imply engine conformance.
